basic_info.description: SF charm meets modern comforts in this freshly renovated Edwardian home. Dream, walkable location on a tranquil tree-lined street in the heart of Glen Park. This modernized gem offers a flexible floor plan & inviting living spaces filled w/ natural light. The Main Level welcomes you w/ shimmering views from sweeping bay windows. Cooking is a joy in the chef's Kitchen w/ maple cabinetry, quartz CT, & SS appls. The open & connected Dining Rm flows to an outdoor Patio & private Garden, great for entertaining, BBQ's, & gathering w/ family & friends. Enjoy sparkling vistas from the grand Brazilian Ipe deck while sipping your favorite evening refresher. A polished Bath & Laundry Rm complete this level. The Top Level greets you w/ 2 light-filled Bedrooms & a bright spa-like Bath. The Primary Level is a private retreat w/ sun-filled Bedroom, gleaming Bath, luxurious Walk-In Closet, & luminous Flex Room for Home Office, Nursery, Reading/Music Lounge, Studio, or 4th Bedroom. Add'l Flex space for Workout Rm, Wine Cellar, etc. Expanded & renovated down to the studs. Spacious 2-car Garage & Storage. Steps to the vibrant shops & restaurants of Glen Park village. Easy access to schools, parks, 280, 101, BART, & Tech shuttles. Don't miss this opportunity to experience quintessential SF living!
